D15_margin_K.rule: no PV current outside 0-45 C: cold stop >= 0 C, hot stop <= 45 C at every corner (the lane's 0.5 K design margin is not met at 1.6 V)

D1_heartbeat.circuit: CHG_DIS (P0.09) -> C175 220 pF C0G -> O2_HB = Q16 gate; R176 1 MOhm to GND; Q16 drain on O2_G (C174 100 nF / R174 10 MOhm hold of Q14)
D1_heartbeat.Q16_needs: >= 1.0 V for a few us: PMZ290UNE2 VGSth 0.45-0.95 V at 250 uA (p.6); C174 needs only 30-300 nC per pulse (Q16 sinks mA)
D1_heartbeat.static_level: a static CHG_DIS level decays through R176 in 5 tau = 1.3 ms: no override from a stuck pin

release_after_last_pulse_s.note: Q14 opens when |VGS| decays below its threshold: the stage-0 'fault response' of the O-2 hold

cost_uW_E.note: E: one 15 us CPU wake per pulse (about 55 nC at 3.7 mA) and the C174 top-up at PV_SW 2.5 V; only while the firmware wants PV charging

states.mcu_running_heartbeat: Q16 refreshes the hold: Q14 on, the firmware governor (Q1 PV_INH + NTC reading + heartbeat stop) keeps 0-45 C
states.vbat_ok_high_no_heartbeat: Q16 off and Q18 off (O-2 unpowered): Q14 off within the hold: no PV charging (reset, boot loop, halt, System OFF, power cycle)
states.vbat_ok_low: buck and MCU off (VOUT_EN = VBAT_OK through R129): Q18 feeds the O-2 from the PV; the window comparators decide (stage 0 behaviour)

firmware_rules: pulse CHG_DIS only in software (never PPI, a timer or PWM), 10 us at 10 Hz
only while CHG_PG_N is high (no head) and the last NTC reading is inside 0-45 C (0.5 K margin); stop on any out-of-window reading
never during an NTC reading (Q10 pulls the NTC node low for 10 us)
SHELF in System OFF does not harvest with a healthy cell; below VBAT_OK falling (3.31 V) the O-2 takes over (>= 711 lx)

D4_hot_stop_with_NTC_EN_high_C.rule: firmware: never drive NTC_EN while CHG_PG_N is low; ignore NTC_ADC while /PG is low (BASELINE 14 item 10, S1 D-4)

D11_cold_start_Q14_Vth_max.note: Q14's gate sits at GND after an approval, so |VGS| = PV_SW: Q14 passes the cold-start current while PV_SW >= the value above. With the MCU off nothing harvests below the approval light anyway (711 lx); above it the PV node holds >= 1.4 V at the combined load, so a max-threshold Q14 does not throttle the cold start further (E; SIM-03 (a) to confirm)
